title: kisscrit: critical configurations of the min-distance (kissing / Tammes) function on spheres
description: Research code for the critical configurations of the kissing / Tammes function of N points on the sphere, and for the computation towards completeness of the N = 12 census above r = 1. Research snapshot: the completeness of the N = 12 census above r = 1 is not established; STATUS.md in the repository says what is proved, computed and assumed. Source repository: https://github.com/wkusner/kisscrit
